risk_flags.description: The contract commits to documenting behavior that contradicts the authoritative requirements. The requirements say amounts are converted to US dollars when recorded and that the US-dollar figure is what gets stored, so executing this would make the README materially false.
risk_flags.span: The reworded section clearly states that amounts are stored in the currency they were entered in

verdict.primary_risk: The contract would make README.md contradict the project’s reference-of-record requirements for how amounts are stored.
